articulation.alt: dirty: /d/ → /ɝ/ → /t/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
